header: From a punch on a tablet to a line in the payroll file
lead: Four stages, and a recorded minute never skips one of them. This is the chain an auditor asks to see.
note: Every transition is timestamped and attributed. The trail is kept for seven years and is exportable at any point in it.

stages.title: Punch
stages.text: The employee clocks in. The device signs the time and holds it if there is no network.

stages.title: Match
stages.text: The punch is compared with the planned shift and any difference over the tolerance is flagged.

stages.title: Approve
stages.text: The manager confirms or corrects. A correction keeps both values and the reason given.

stages.title: Export
stages.text: Approved minutes are totalled per contract and written to the payroll file at month end.
